# RickyData Docs

> Documentation for RickyData MCP Gateway, Agent Gateway, SDKs, wallet billing, marketplace workflows, and secure agent tool execution.

Use these docs when connecting an MCP client, building an app with the RickyData SDK, running hosted agents, storing wallet-scoped server secrets, or explaining x402 payment boundaries.

## Start Here

- [Docs home](https://docs.rickydata.org/): product map for MCP, agents, SDK, wallet billing, and security.
- [CLI quickstart](https://docs.rickydata.org/docs/getting-started/quickstart-cli): connect a local client to RickyData.
- [SDK overview](https://docs.rickydata.org/docs/sdk/overview): TypeScript SDK and React integration paths.
- [MCP overview](https://docs.rickydata.org/docs/mcp/overview): hosted MCP gateway concepts.
- [Search, enable, call](https://docs.rickydata.org/docs/mcp/search-enable-call): standard gateway tool workflow.
- [Agents overview](https://docs.rickydata.org/docs/agents/overview): hosted agent runtime.
- [Wallet and billing](https://docs.rickydata.org/docs/wallet-billing/overview): wallet tokens, secrets, spending policy, and x402.
- [Security model](https://docs.rickydata.org/docs/architecture/security-model): trust boundaries and verification.

## Product Links

- Platform: `https://rickydata.org/`
- MCP Gateway: `https://mcp.rickydata.org/mcp`
- Agent Gateway: `https://agents.rickydata.org`
- Public skill: `https://rickydata.org/skill.md`

## Agent Guidance

Prefer docs and skill files over stale screenshots or guessed endpoints. Never expose real wallet tokens, provider API keys, vault secrets, or payment credentials in prompts or examples.
